scope: Independent complete static review of the exact v3 materializer, full diff from accepted v2, accepted revision-3 plan/manifest identities and both author self-audits.
checked_guards: Windows-only execution, fixed isolated store cwd, fixed qualified executable and exact manifest/binary hash checks before preflight and immediately before the single commit.

Read-only reuse of restore-v3.json with successful local recovery, no secret quarantine, exact generation/root/UUID, 954 issues, 11264 events and no nonempty override. No restore command exists in the helper.
Refusal of an original commit receipt and any v2 started/commit/result record; the original inventory exit must match the reviewed status-1 aborted attempt.
Accepted manifest version, all 17 unique local IDs and stable references, 26 blocks edges with valid local endpoints, and exactly 43 operations.

All v3 command streams, exit records and start/result records must be absent. The task-owned TEMP directory must be newly created. Case variants of TEMP/TMP and workspace overrides are removed only from the native children's copied environment.

Exclusive start marker before native commands, fresh exclusive output writes, hidden shell-free argv execution, per-command timeout and bounded output. Stdout, stderr and exit outcome are retained before status assertions; no command retry is implemented.
Complete initial inventory contains exactly 954 distinct issues and all 17 namespace lookups must return empty arrays before dry-run or commit.
Dry-run requires 43 semantic changes, 17 creates and 26 dependency results. One commit requires the same counts, successful created outcomes and a complete unique actual-ID map.

Post-commit inventory must contain exactly 971 distinct issues. Every original full inventory record must remain identical; every new title, complete description, priority, base status, label set, resource set and created issue type is checked against the accepted manifest.

All 26 actual dependency edges, including direction and kind, must exactly match the accepted graph. The result records actual IDs, exact hashes, restore receipt, retained temporary directory and restore_replayed=false.
revision_changes: Pins accepted revision-3 manifest and reports continuation_revision=3.
Uses fresh manifest-v3.json, temp-materialize-v3 and v3 output/marker/result paths.
Adds explicit refusal of prior v2 started, commit and result records.
Updates the comment to the actual successful child-TEMP inventory observation without claiming a more specific cause of the old directory failure.

execution_boundary.verdict: The exact reviewed candidate may be published and executed once by root against the verified isolated store and accepted manifest.
execution_boundary.uncertain_outcome: An existing marker/output, nonzero exit, timeout or interrupted response requires reconciliation of saved outputs, actual records and process state before another mutation. Acceptance does not authorize clearing these guards or replaying restore/commit.
execution_boundary.completion: Actual materialization acceptance still requires the saved successful v3 result and full readback. Browser, production tray and installation gates remain separate.

git_result: Independent review record only; root handles publication.
